_comment: [JJ] Product & infrastructure backlog — scored for autonomous prioritization

items.title: Build URL health check CLI tool
items.detail: Zero-dep Node.js tool that checks all active vendor URLs in products.json. HEAD requests with GET fallback, redirect following, configurable timeout, exit code 1 on failures.

items.title: Add weekly URL health check GitHub Actions workflow
items.detail: Scheduled workflow (Mondays 09:00 UTC) runs node tools/health/index.js. Exits 1 on dead URLs so failures are visible in GitHub. Also manually triggerable.

items.title: Manually verify 2 Zazzle listings returning 403
items.detail: First health check run (2026-05-31) flagged showdown-grand-theft-army and unba-bottom-fifth as returning 403. Open both URLs in browser to confirm live vs dead. If dead, set vendor active: false in products.json. See B-006.
items.completionNote: Both URLs confirmed live by Jeff. Zazzle bot-blocking returns 403 for automated requests. Health check tool updated to treat 403 as warning, not failure.

items.title: Implement unavailable product card state
items.detail: When all vendors for a product are active: false, render a muted card with 'Currently unavailable' instead of a broken CTA. CSS class .jj-card--unavailable, pointer-events: none, aria-disabled.

items.title: Add missing TAG_MAP entries (greek, emotion, love, expression, rights)
items.detail: Tags used in products.json have no TAG_MAP expansion: greek, emotion, love, expression, rights, humor. These products fill to MAX_TAGS with generic words instead of relevant keywords — directly hurting search rank on Zazzle and Redbubble.

items.title: Fix duplicate 'retro' key in TAG_MAP (zazzle.js)
items.detail: zazzle.js TAG_MAP has 'retro' defined twice. Second definition silently overwrites the first in JS objects — 'throwback' is lost from the expansion. Products with 'retro' tag get an incorrect expansion.

items.title: Audit and improve per-product base tags in products.json
items.detail: Several products have weak or incomplete base tags: sig-zazzle-icon-2020 missing 'zazzle', sig-redbubble-icon missing 'redbubble', warez-hello-world missing 'computing', irrational-pi-symbol has 'greek' (no expansion). Improving base tags = better search coverage.

items.title: Write sync tool README.md
items.detail: tools/sync/ has no README. Document all commands, workflow (edit products.json → diff → export → update platform → mark-synced), and file structure. Required for future maintainability and handoff.

items.title: Create og:image for social share previews
items.detail: index.html has og:title, og:description, og:url but no og:image. Social shares (Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord) show a blank preview. A static 1200x630 image would make every shared link display a branded preview card.

items.title: Resolve HTML5 Logo T-Shirt Zazzle variant (two SKUs in memory notes)
items.detail: Memory notes show two Zazzle URLs for HTML5 Logo T-Shirt: -256071083697467896 and -256951261407813372. products.json uses the first. Confirm which is the canonical listing or whether both should appear.

items.title: Verify multi-vendor UI for all 4 cross-platform products
items.detail: Vendor selector UI was built (issue #13). Manual check needed: confirm all 4 cross-platform products show both vendor buttons, buttons open correct URLs, single-vendor products still use card-link behavior. Addresses Phase 3B issue #7.

items.title: Write Phase 3B architecture documentation
items.detail: Phase 3B issue #8. Document the multi-vendor schema design, sync tool architecture, platform formatter pattern, and future API integration path. Captures decisions made this week while context is fresh.

items.title: WCAG AA accessibility audit on index.html
items.detail: Rule #14 in jeffjenx.md: accessibility is non-negotiable. Review index.html for: color contrast on vendor buttons, keyboard navigation of product cards, ARIA labels on interactive elements, screen reader compatibility of dynamic JSON-LD injection.

items.title: Set up Ko-fi and activate digital downloads collection
items.detail: products.json has digital collection ready (active: false). Ko-fi has 0% platform fee vs Gumroad 10%. When icons are ready: create Ko-fi store, add product entries with type: 'digital', set digital collection active: true.
items.blocker: Icons not yet ready for sale

items.title: Investigate Zazzle/Redbubble API availability
items.detail: Phase 3B issues #3 and #4. Both platform API doc URLs return 404. Monitor for future availability. Cannot build true sync without APIs.
items.blocker: APIs not publicly available (404 on both doc pages as of May 2026)

items.title: Hash-based URL routing for shop collection filters
items.detail: jeffjenx.com/#www, /#warez etc. deep-link to a filtered collection view. Filter clicks update window.location.hash via history.replaceState. hashchange listener syncs browser back/forward navigation. getHashFilter() validates hash against collection IDs before applying.

items.title: Dynamic schema.org Product JSON-LD from products.json
items.detail: buildStructuredData() function generates a CollectionPage + ItemList with one Product entry per active product (name, description, offers per vendor). Injected as <script type=application/ld+json> after products.json loads. Improves Google discoverability. No product images yet — add image field to products.json + upload thumbnails to complete.
items.completionNote: Fixed product URL to point to /products/{id}/ (not vendor URL). Added priceCurrency: USD to offers. Added image field support (renders when product.image is set).

items.title: Add Share button to product cards
items.detail: Each product card gets a Share button in the card footer. Clicking copies the /products/{id}/ URL to clipboard (navigator.clipboard with textarea fallback). Shows 'Copied!' feedback for 1.8s. Prevents card navigation/picker from firing when share is clicked. Dark mode support via CSS custom properties.

items.title: Full dark mode on all product pages
items.detail: Generator upgraded to output complete dark mode CSS: prefers-color-scheme auto-detection, data-theme override, theme toggle button in nav (localStorage persist). All 24 pages regenerated.

items.title: Share button on all product pages
items.detail: Generator adds a Share button to every product page. Copies canonical URL to clipboard (navigator.clipboard + execCommand fallback). Copied feedback state with dark mode support.

items.title: Also-in-Collection cross-sell on product pages
items.detail: Generator builds static sibling-product links at generation time (up to 4 per page). Displays as pill links in a bordered section above the back link. Improves internal linking and session depth.

items.title: Human Tasks panel in admin dashboard
items.detail: admin/index.html now includes a Human Tasks section with 11 pre-populated tasks (stickers, designs, thumbnails, Gumroad). localStorage persistence, priority tiers, group display, mark-done + clear-done controls.

items.title: Add manifest.json and humans.txt
items.detail: manifest.json created (PWA installability, theme colors). humans.txt created. manifest linked in shop index.html head. robots.txt updated to reference humans.txt.

items.title: Create and list TypeScript Logo T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry www-typescript-logo is in products.json (active: false). TAG_MAP entries added. Create design using official TypeScript logo (MIT licensed). Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs to products.json draft entry, set active: true, remove _draft field.

items.title: Create and list Node.js Logo T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry www-nodejs-logo is in products.json (active: false). TAG_MAP entries added. Create design using Node.js logo (guidelines at nodejs.org/en/about/trademark). Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs, set active: true, remove _draft field.

items.title: Create and list 'It Works on My Machine' T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry warez-it-works is in products.json (active: false). Text-based design — low design effort. Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs, set active: true, remove _draft field. High meme-factor = high organic share potential.

items.title: Create and list Blue Screen of Death T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry warez-bsod is in products.json (active: false). TAG_MAP entries added. Iconographic/retro design. Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs, set active: true, remove _draft field.

items.title: Create and list Euler's Number T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry irrational-euler is in products.json (active: false). TAG_MAP entries added. Typography-only design — low effort. Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs, set active: true, remove _draft field.

items.title: Create and list '640K Ought to Be Enough' T-Shirt (Phase 4B)
items.detail: Draft entry warez-640k added to products.json (active: false, 2026-05-31). Text-based design quoting the apocryphal Bill Gates line. Upload to Zazzle and Redbubble. Add vendor URLs, set active: true, remove _draft field. High nerd-recognition factor.

items.title: Enable stickers on all 6 Redbubble designs (Phase 4C)
items.detail: Redbubble auto-generates sticker, mug, tote, and phone case listings from existing artwork at no extra design cost. Log in to Redbubble, enable additional product types for all 6 designs. No products.json change needed. Zero design effort — pure revenue expansion.

items.title: Add product images to shop cards (index.html)
items.detail: Product pages (generator) already support product.image field for og:image, twitter:image, JSON-LD, and visual area. Remaining work: add product card images to the main shop grid. Add image field to each product entry in products.json, host 400x400 thumbnails at /images/products/{id}/thumb.jpg. Zazzle and Redbubble both have downloadable product preview images.

items.title: Anti-FOUC head scripts across all sites and generator
items.detail: Added inline anti-FOUC script to <head> on jeffjenx.com, jeffjenx.design (index + all 3 sub-pages), jeffjenx.net, and all 24 generated product pages. Dark mode users no longer see a flash of light mode on any page.

items.title: Shop wow-factor: skeleton loading, instant search, card animations, dark mode transitions
items.detail: Skeleton loading: 6 shimmer placeholder cards appear immediately on page load before fetch completes. Instant search: setupSearch() with 80ms debounce, filter bar hides while searching, search meta shows count. Card entrance animation: CSS @keyframes with nth-child stagger (40/80/80/120/120ms). Dark mode: body/nav/footer color transitions on theme toggle. All reduced-motion safe.

items.title: Filter buttons show product counts per collection
items.detail: buildFilters() now appends (All 24), (WWW 5), etc. to each filter button. Count is computed at runtime from active products only. Persists on activeFilterBtn() class change since only className is updated.

items.title: Branded 404 page
items.detail: Created 404.html matching shop design: [JJ] nav, anti-FOUC, theme toggle, 'Browse the Shop →' CTA, footer nav links. No canonical tag (correct for error pages).

items.title: Generator: product.image support for og:image, visual area, and JSON-LD
items.detail: tools/generate/index.js updated: when product.image is set, og:image and twitter:image use the product image instead of fallback og-image.png; JSON-LD adds 'image' field; .pg-visual renders tag instead of collection mark character. All 24 product pages regenerated. Code-ready for Phase 5A image uploads.

items.title: og:image:alt + twitter:image:alt on all sites and generator
items.detail: Added descriptive og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt meta tags to jeffjenx.com, jeffjenx.design (all 4 pages), jeffjenx.net, and all 24 generated product pages. Improves screen reader accessibility of social share previews.

items.title: URL-addressable search + Google Sitelinks Search Box
items.detail: Search queries now reflected in URL as ?q=term via history.replaceState. On load, ?q= param restores search state (enables sharing and browser back nav). Added SearchAction potentialAction to WebSite JSON-LD for Google Sitelinks Search Box eligibility.
